messages:
Maya (CS): Quick weekly check-in for Nebula Retail — short summary below, looking for ops + AE input.

Maya (CS): High-level: usage up 12% w/w, spend +9% (over forecast), error rate ticked to 1.8% (was 0.4%), and we’re seeing a larger p99 gap on non-streaming routes.

Li (SRE): Raw latency samples (last 24h, 95/99 in ms) by route/model: 
- /inference/chat (redwood/psi-7b): streaming p95 160, p99 370; non-streaming p95 310, p99 980.
- /inference/summary (open/llama2-13b): streaming p95 220, p99 540; non-streaming p95 430, p99 1200.
- /embed/vector (open/embed-1): p95 45, p99 120 (no streaming).

Li (SRE): Error breakdown: 67% are transient GPU OOM retries on heavy context windows (customer is sending long histories), 22% are 5xx infra pacing on one dedicated pool, rest are client timeouts.

Sam (Solutions): Noted. Onboarding cohort currently uses both streaming and sync routes; customers prefer streaming for chat UX. Can we make a recommended toggle for them?

Li (SRE): Suggested quick mitigations: enable streaming for chat-heavy endpoints (low effort), set prefix-KV caching for common system prompts, bump dedicated pool autoscale min by 1 node during peak window (02:00-06:00 UTC).

Li (SRE): Example API patch we can push to their route config: 
```
PATCH /v1/routes/nebularetail/chat 
{
  "prefer_streaming": true,
  "max_sequence_length": 2048,
  "batch_max_tokens": 512
}
```

Maya (CS): Cost note — switching chat to streaming reduces token-side latency and often cuts tokens billed for long-lived sessions by ~12% (our sim). But autoscale bump adds fixed hourly node cost; net impact estimated +6% this week.

Josh (AE): Renewal check — are we in danger? If spend stays +9% and errors persist, risk moves from green to yellow. Any quick wins to reduce spend without harming UX?

Sam (Solutions): Quick wins: enforce max_history_tokens on client side, trim system prompts, route non-essential batch workloads to cheaper models (open/embed-1 for embeddings, smaller redwood/psi-3b for short replies).

Li (SRE): Long-term: quantize larger models for that customer (they have private/dedicated pools, we can roll q4 experiment), schedule model-variant fallback rules for overloaded nodes. Immediate action item: I’ll deploy streaming toggle + KV caching today and monitor for 6 hours.

Maya (CS): Action items: 
- Li: deploy streaming toggle + KV caching, report p95/p99 after 6h (assigned).
- Sam: prepare client-side guidance (trim history, max_history_tokens) and a short one-pager for Nebula devs.
- Josh: flag to renewal team — potential yellow if spend/error trend continues next week.

Josh (AE): Thanks — I’ll loop in renewal lead and send heads-up email if Li's numbers don't improve after the deploy window. :thumbsup:

OncallBot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0892 (auto) — tracking Nebula Retail transient OOM spikes; assigned to Li.

Li (SRE): Quick telemetry note: if p99 non-streaming stays >900ms after toggle, we should consider shifting a subset of traffic to a lower-latency variant and enable canary routing (10% -> 50%).

Maya (CS): Great, thanks everyone. Will follow up in tomorrow's sync with a short slide of before/after p95/p99 and cost delta.

Sam (Solutions): cc @NebulaPD for visibility when we send the one-pager.

Josh (AE): End of thread — ping me if you need help drafting the renewal note.
